answer: In PoA, trust propagates through bounded-length random walks on an attestation graph: verified edges transmit limited mass, while an adversarial sybil cluster connects to honest nodes through a sparse external cut. Low conductance bounds the probability that walks enter the cluster; min-cut transitivity then bounds its total reachable trust and aggregate voting weight, preventing internal endorsements from compounding. Thus an oasis of collusion is a hollow pearl without diverse attestations.
